Environment.description: The fixture environment a trial runs against.

base_url.description: Fixture service URL the agent must use for every tool call.
base_url.title: Base Url

Environment.title: Environment

ResumeFrom.description: Continue a prior run from one of its checkpoints. Only for adapters declaring resume/fork.

checkpoint_id.description: `checkpoint_id` from one of that trial's `checkpoint_saved` events.
checkpoint_id.title: Checkpoint Id

ResumeFrom.title: ResumeFrom

ToolFault.description: A scripted tool failure. Applied by the fixture service, or by the harness when sent in `tool_faults`.

tool.description: Name of the tool to break.
tool.title: Tool

when.description: Which calls fail: `first_call`, `always`, or an integer N for the Nth call (1-based).

action.description: `timeout_after_commit`: the side effect happens but the caller sees a failure. `error_before_commit`: the call fails with no side effect.

ToolFault.title: ToolFault

description: Body of `POST /invoke`: one trial for the harness to run.

protocol_version.description: Wire protocol version of the sender.
protocol_version.title: Protocol Version

trial_id.description: Unique id of this trial (one scenario, one repeat, one target).
trial_id.title: Trial Id

system_version.description: Version label of the system under test, from the target config.
system_version.title: System Version

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this invocation (`<trial_id>:invoke`), so a harness can de-duplicate a retried request.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

input.description: The scenario's `input`, handed to the agent as-is.

deadline_ms.description: Time budget for the whole invocation, in milliseconds.
deadline_ms.title: Deadline Ms

traceparent.description: W3C `traceparent` header value, so the harness can join the runner's trace.
traceparent.title: Traceparent

tool_faults.description: Faults the harness must apply at its own tool boundary; sent only to `intercept_tools="declared_only"`.
tool_faults.title: Tool Faults

resume_from.description: Checkpoint to continue from, for resume/fork runs.

title: InvokeRequest
